description: Stores and finds invoices, one JSON file per invoice in the data folder

decisions.question: Where and in which format is the data kept - e.g. one JSON file per invoice in data/invoices/, or a SQLite table?
decisions.answer: One file NUMBER.json in data_dir, the fields of the invoice, amount as a string
choices: One JSON file per item in a data folder

decisions.question: Not found (e.g. get("F-42") when it does not exist): return None, or raise which domain error?
decisions.answer: Return None; the service raises the domain error
decisions.suggested: Return None; the service raises the domain error

decisions.question: A crash while writing (e.g. the disk is full after half a file): how does a reader never see a half-written record - write to a temporary file then rename, or a transaction?
decisions.answer: Write to a temporary file next to it, then rename it
decisions.suggested: Write to a temporary file next to it, then rename it

decisions.question: Two runs write the same record at the same moment: the last one wins, the second one is refused, or the second one waits (a lock)?
decisions.answer: The last one wins: marking paid twice gives the same file

questions.title: GDPR
questions.question: Retention: how long is the personal data it writes kept, how is it deleted then, and how is one person's data erased on request (art. 17) - e.g. 5 years, then deleted; one person's rows deleted by id?
questions.answer: 10 years (accounting law), then the file is deleted; one person's invoices are kept until then (legal obligation)

questions.title: GDPR
questions.question: Location: in which country or region is it stored? Outside the EU/EEA, which safeguard applies (adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses - art. 46) - e.g. France, cloud region eu-west-3?
questions.answer: The company's file server, in France

safety.question: Something missing (an input, a file, a setting, a dependency down): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: A missing file is reported as None, the service raises InvoiceNotFoundError (decision 2)

safety.question: Too much (duplicates, an unbounded list, a huge file): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: It reads one invoice at a time, by number

safety.question: Half done (a file half written, a change saved here and not there, a crash in the middle): what must never happen?

hazards.description: An invoice file is half written

prevented_by.statement: an invoice file is complete or absent

safety.question: Old data used as current (a cache, an old file): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Nothing is cached: every call reads the file

safety.question: Two runs at the same time (two processes, two users): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Concurrent writes give the same paid invoice (decision 4)

safety.question: Data exposed (secrets or personal data in a log, an output, an error message): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Files stay in the data folder; nothing is logged
